results.fact: Round-trip distance: dist_km vs. itinerary total
results.evidence: Still real: dist_km 5.9 km (3.7 mi, trailhead to Cascade Pass only) against the approach's 5-6 mi to camp, itinerary day 1 6.5 mi, the Kool-Aid Lake waypoint's 7.2 mi and totalNote's ~16 mi round trip. New sources add nothing firm: a traverse guide gives only the 3.7 mi to Cascade Pass and says the cross-country mileage beyond is hard to track, and a GPS route page gives 5.5 mi / 3,307 ft to Kool-Aid Lake. No two sources agree on a one-way figure.

Still real: grade 'Grade II, Class 3-4' and pitch_detail (3-4 finish) against rock_grade 'Class 2-3 (scramble)' and climbing_route's 2-3. No new source on the retry gives a rating for the south ridge; the earlier split (class 3; class 2-3; exposed class 3-4 between false and true summits) stands, so no single value is established.

results.fact: Kool-Aid Lake elevation: 6,200 (waypoint, approach_variants) vs 6,320 (approach, itinerary day 1 note)
results.correct_value: Kool-Aid Lake is at about 6,120 ft
results.evidence: The USGS elevation service returns 6,119-6,121 ft at three points on the mapped lake polygon (centre 48.43867, -121.04581), a flat water surface. A Ptarmigan Traverse description gives 6,120 ft and a map gazetteer 6,119 ft. Neither 6,320 nor 6,200 is right; every copy on the row is set to 6,120.
